title: It’s ok.
text: It’s ok.. It’s a great looking desk if you can receive it without damage to the desktop.

product_metadata.title: Tangkula Computer Desk with 4 Storage Drawers & Hutch, Home Office Desk Vintage Desk with Storage Shelves, Wooden Executive Desk Writing Study Desk (Brown)
features: Large Storage Capacity with File Drawer: This writing desk has a spacious tabletop for your arms to move while working or studying. 3 small drawers can be used to store books, office supplies and other essentials. 1 bottom drawer with hanging rods keeps letter-sized files organized for easy access. Moreover, metal slide rails and humanized handles allow for a smooth opening.

Considerate Monitor Stand & Cable Hole: This computer desk features an extra monitor stand, creating a dedicated storage space for your gaming accessories and other equipments. Meanwhile, it helps elevate your monitor screen to relieve back pain. Plus, a cable management hole on the back helps organize wires efficiently and reduces clutter.

Vintage Style Desk for Multiple Purposes: This desk can be used as a computer desk, as well as a writing desk, work station, gaming desk depending on your different needs. Thanks to the refined wood grain that adds a touch of elegance and retro visual appeal, the computer desk seamlessly blends into any decorative style, perfect for the bedroom, study, office, etc.

Super Sturdy & Durable Construction: Made of high-quality and thickened MDF boards, this computer desk delivers outstanding sturdiness, stability and durability. The table top can hold 132 lbs without wobbling, while each drawer can withstand up to 20 lbs. This vintage computer desk with textured surface is scratch-resistant, hard-wearing and waterproof.

Hassle-free Assembly & Low Maintenance: With detailed instructions and all the necessary accessories, this writing desk is super easy to put together. It will take you minimal time and effort to complete the assembly of this desk. In addition, the smooth surface with delicate finish is convenient to clean in daily life, just gently wipe it with a soft cloth.
